text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh dear...? How strange. Is nobody here?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Geez... I dashed all the way here because 
I heard someone calling out "Princess~"!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Three Goddesses, Three Goddesses, 
would you happen to know who that voice 
belongs to?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Just kidding, you wouldn't tell me 
something like that anyway, would you—
